values: 一名擅长使用黑暗魔法削弱敌人的射手，能化作黑雾躲避危险。
A Marksman skilled at using dark magic to weaken enemies and transforming into mist to avoid danger.
Copy that. I'll take care of it.
Don't worry... I'll clear the way.
很有意思，谢谢……？人类收到礼物是要这么说吧？
Interesting. Thank you. This is what people say when they get gifts, right?
命运叫她握紧手中的弓箭。
She pulls the string, letting destiny fly with each arrow.
当狂想的幻梦被鲜妍色彩包裹，她是否更靠近箭矢尽处的自由？
Feathers of fantasy carry her toward the horizon her arrow seeks.
金玫瑰高定商店兑换获得。
I feel out of place here...
So many people here... Even the air becomes warm...
酒……为什么有人如此沉迷？
Why are some people addicted to alcohol?
These decorations must have taken so much time.
Let's go prepare the banquet on the ship.
Let's enjoy the holiday to the fullest!
波妮并不是由人变成的亡灵，她没有生前的记忆，自她诞生以来就是亡灵。
Unlike others, Bonnie wasn't transformed from a human into a Graveborn. She has no memories of being human and has been a Graveborn since birth.
波妮喜欢羽毛。轻飘飘的羽毛从天空坠落，不知飘向何方落在何地，常常会吸引她的视线。
Bonnie has a fascination with feathers. She's always captivated by their light and airy descent from the sky, drifting aimlessly and landing in unexpected places.
波妮自己都没有发现，她喜欢射箭，是因为箭簇总能代替她去到更远的地方——她去不到的地方。
It hasn't dawned on Bonnie that her love for archery stems from the unconscious feeling that her arrows seem to fly farther than she could ever imagine.
波妮擅长观察和追踪，作为死潮舰队的王牌射手，她能辨别空气中及其细微的微尘变化，迅速察觉敌人的攻击从哪个方向而来。
Bonnie excels in observation and tracking. As the Dead Tide Fleet's ace sharpshooter, she can detect even the subtlest changes in the dust, swiftly identifying the direction of enemy attacks.
波妮誓死追随死潮舰长霍德希金，从不质疑他的命令，每次都能出色地完成任务，因此她也是霍德希金最信任的下属。
Bonnie is determined to follow Captain Hodgkin until the end. She never questions his orders and always completes her tasks. She is definitely Hodgkin's most trusted ally.
波妮偶尔会羡慕曾是人类的亡灵，因为他们有过去。没有过去的她，出生即是死亡，死亡的尽头又是什么呢？她找不到答案。
At times, Bonnie envies those who had lived as humans, for they had a past to remember. Her own birth began with death, leaving her to question what lies beyond death, an answer she has not found.
波妮做任何事都一丝不苟，为了确保箭无虚发，她会在海面放插着羽毛的漂流瓶，即使闭眼也能精准射中，她才会停止训练。

Bonnie is meticulous in everything she does. She practices by setting feather-topped drift bottles on the ocean's surface and trains until she can strike each with perfect accuracy with her eyes closed, no less.
死潮舰队的成员既惧怕又仰慕波妮，有时为了得到波妮的青睐，他们执行波妮安排的任务时会更加卖力。当然，这种竞争偶尔也会闹出笑话。

The members of the Dead Tide Fleet both fear and admire Bonnie, often putting extra effort into the missions she assigns to gain her favor. Naturally, this competition sometimes results in playful banter.
不知为何，波妮看到奈拉的第一眼，就希望做她的姐姐照顾她，但奈拉却像被踩到尾巴的猫一样，不愿叫姐姐，也拒绝她的靠近。

From their first meeting, Bonnie immediately felt a sisterly bond with Nara and wanted to care for her. But Nara reacted like a cornered lobster waving its claws. She was unwilling to acknowledge Bonnie as a sister and avoided her.
波妮不喜欢听被折磨的惨叫，也厌恶为了折磨而折磨的行为，因此奈拉总是和她合不来。
Bonnie can't stand the sound of tortured screams and despises senseless torture, which is why she often clashes with Nara.
这里的人没有恶意,您不必担心。
Please don't worry. The people here have no ill intentions.
看起来你最近过得不错。
Looks like you've been faring well lately.
I feel out of place here...
酒……为什么有人如此沉迷？
Why are some people addicted to alcohol?
These decorations must have taken so much time.
Let's go prepare the banquet on the ship.
Let's enjoy the holiday to the fullest!
Hey, pinkskin. Move out of the way.
